verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a vendor-maintained migration guide covering two strategies, basic export/import and trickle migration. It also ships an open-source tool that bulk-creates users from JSON or CSV through the Backend API and respects rate limits. The evidence never says that existing password hashes are preserved or that users avoid a forced password reset, and no provider-specific guides are shown. missing for 10: explicit password-hash import / no-reset guarantee, competitor-specific migration guides (e.g., per-provider export instructions), independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration.
